No teaching moment

From a reel straight to a call

Someone who just found you has to go from watching one post to booking a call with a stranger. Most people in the middle of a breakup aren't ready to take that step yet.

No qualifier

Your calendar does the filtering

An open Calendly link means anyone can book. Your time goes on calls with people who were curious, not ready, or not able to invest.

No list engine

Growth depends on today's post

With no class capturing emails every day, new clients appear when a reel lands, and the quiet weeks show up in your calendar.

The people who watch every reel but aren't ready to book a call have nowhere to go, so most of them stay in the loop alone.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Who is this class for?

Anyone out of a toxic relationship who keeps checking, replaying and going back in their head, and wants to stop obsessing, detach and rebuild their confidence.

How long is it, and is it live?

It's a 60-minute live online class with Viktoria, with live Q&A at the end.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay for 48 hours, so you can watch in your own time.

Why is it $17 and not free?

A small price means everyone in the room has decided to show up for themselves. You also get the worksheet and the 7-day plan.

Is this therapy?

No. This is a coaching and education class. It isn't therapy or medical advice.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Why you keep checking"

Hook
"If you've opened their profile three times today and promised yourself it was the last time, watch this." (to camera, close framing)
Body
"Checking isn't a lack of willpower. After a relationship like that, your mind keeps looking for answers it isn't going to find there. The way out isn't forcing yourself to stop. It's knowing exactly what to do in the moment the urge hits." (cut to Viktoria writing in a notebook)
CTA
"I'm teaching the full routine in a 60-minute masterclass called Break the Cycle. It's $17. Tap Sign up to get your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three signs you're still in the loop"

Hook
"Three signs the breakup is over, but the cycle isn't." (Viktoria counts on her fingers, text on screen)
Body
"One: you still plan your day around whether they've posted. Two: you rehearse conversations you'll never have. Three: you've said 'I'm over it' more times than you've felt it. None of that means something is wrong with you. It means the attachment hasn't loosened yet." (on-screen captions for each sign)
CTA
"In my masterclass I'll walk you through how to loosen it, step by step. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"What 400+ clients taught me"

Hook
"I've helped more than 400 people through this, and the same thing comes up almost every time." (walking, natural light, greenery behind)
Body
"People think they need to understand why it happened before they can move on. Usually it's the other way round. Detach first, rebuild your confidence, and the clarity comes after. That's the order I teach."
CTA
"It's all in my 60-minute masterclass, Break the Cycle. $17, with a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
